5252.title: Claude plugin UI notifications generate diagnostics
5252.rootCauseOneLine: The provider's closed system-subtype allow-list reduces plugin-UI notifications to unknown, so the translator emits diagnostic unhandled events.
5252.proposedFix: Explicitly classify the seven tested UI notification subtypes as noise while preserving diagnostics for unknown events.
5252.caveats: Verified with independently authored SDK envelopes at the real translator/assembler boundary in two clean checkouts. Live upstream emission, introduction version, macOS behavior, and notification frequency were not exercised. Full provider suite passes as non-root; five unrelated bridge tests fail under UID 0.
